context_for_next_testing_agent: The 0->1 first-order alert fix using hasSeededOrderCountRef is verified working. Kitchen at /runner/cozinha starts with 0 received + 0 pending PIX (prazo_pending orders don't count toward the alert counter). Use curl (not urllib) for POST /api/orders — urllib is blocked by 403 (likely UA filter). Model requires items[].menu_item_id.
rca of the issue: Original bug: prevOrderCount.current was initialized to 0. On first fetch, if there were 0 pending orders, newPendingCount (0) was not > prevOrderCount.current (0), so no alert. But when the first ever order arrived (0->1), the condition `newPendingCount > prevOrderCount.current` (1>0) would fire — however, the earlier seed-guard used a boolean that was already true after the mount, causing a false alert on the FIRST page load when orders existed. The fix separates concerns: hasSeededOrderCountRef starts false, is set true only AFTER the first fetch stores prevOrderCount. Now on first fetch: alert is suppressed (ref is false). On any subsequent fetch where count increases: alert fires correctly, including the 0->1 first-order case. Verified end-to-end.
